startup.name: Zavo
startup.one_liner: Data research lab for frontier AI.
startup.description: Research lab that builds data for frontier AI developers across complex domains, in the style of the expert data and evaluation labs that sell to model companies. Eight person team in London, Fall 2025 batch, tags B2B, Big Data and AI. The description gives no customers, domains or pricing, so the buyer is assumed to be a small number of frontier labs paying per project.

yc_acceptance.basis: Starting prior is about 1 percent for a random applicant (0.6 to 2 percent, references/yc_acceptance.md). Up for the timing, since model labs spent heavily on expert data in 2025, and for a team of eight with a research framing. Down because the description is thin and names no customers, and because Surge, Mercor, Scale and a wave of YC data labs already serve the same buyers. Net about 3 percent; the company is already in the batch so this is for completeness.
yc_acceptance.why_it_fails: YC would most likely say that selling data to a handful of frontier labs is a concentrated, lumpy business where Surge, Mercor and Scale hold the relationships, and that a London team with no named lab customer has not shown it can win a contract. Partners would also ask what domain edge a new lab has that the larger vendors cannot buy.

anchors.adjustment_reason: Window is 13.4 months, from 2025-10-06 to 2026-11-17, and counts a round above about 1M from outside investors closing inside it. Anchor 0.64 for the AI tag and 0.59 for B2B, ever. By month 13 to 14 about 65 to 70 percent of eventual 2022 and later seeds close (median 8, p75 14 to 20), so 0.64 times about 0.7 is 0.45, which is 0.7x of the anchor. Hot demand for training data is not lifted above the anchor, per the winners test. These odds do not rank this company against others.

bands.rationale: Small round under 3M, likely from angels or a lab alumni syndicate for a London team.
Institutional seed near the 2022 and later median of 3.5M to 4.1M.
Strong seed if one or two frontier labs are paying customers and revenue grows fast; matches the 6M to 10M press covered quartile.
Large seed in the frontier data category, where a few companies raised big early rounds; rare for eight people with no disclosed revenue.

ladder.why_it_fails: The seed step inside 13.4 months fails if no frontier lab becomes a repeat customer, because demand for expert data is concentrated in a few buyers who can move volume to Surge or Mercor within weeks. Sepal AI, a data company from the Summer 2024 batch, was acquired without a recorded priced round, and Centaur and Superb AI show that labeling businesses can take years to reach a Series B. Investors will also ask why gross margin is not eaten by expert labor costs.

outcomes.why_it_fails: Data vendors to frontier labs often fail when customers insource or concentrate on the leaders, or get bought early for their experts and pipelines as Sepal AI was. A large outcome needs a recurring product beyond one off projects, and that is not visible in the description.

killers.risk: Customer concentration: two or three frontier labs account for most revenue and can switch vendors
killers.evidence: Reports in 2025 describe labs leaving Scale within weeks after the Meta investment and moving work to Surge and Mercor, showing how fast volume moves.
killers.mitigation: Sign multi quarter contracts with several labs and build a repeatable evaluation product.

killers.risk: Margins: expert labor costs of 50 to 200 dollars an hour leave thin margins for a small vendor
killers.evidence: Frontier expert rates of 50 to 200 dollars per hour are reported in 2025 market analyses, and large platforms have scale in sourcing experts.
killers.mitigation: Invest in tooling and quality checks that make each expert hour worth more.

killers.risk: Description is thin and no domain edge is stated, so the company is a generic data vendor
killers.evidence: The input gives only a research lab framing and a contact email, with no named domain, customer or product.
killers.mitigation: Pick a domain with scarce expertise, such as a regulated field, and publish a benchmark.

technical_complexity.rationale: Recruiting and vetting experts, quality control and pipelines for evaluations are operational skills, not deep research, and a small team can start in three months. The hard part is quality at scale and understanding what labs need, which depends on research talent and lab relationships.

who: Labs building in house data teams
takeover_risk.rationale: Large vendors can add any domain by recruiting experts, and labs can insource. A small lab competes on speciality and trust, not on technology, so copy and absorption risk is high.

evidence.claim: Mercor reported about 500M annualized revenue by August 2025 and Surge more than 1B, showing paid demand from labs
Labs moved volume away from Scale to Surge and Mercor within weeks of Meta's investment, so buyers want multiple vendors

narrative.headline: A late entrant to frontier AI data with a thin description; a seed in 13 months is close to a coin flip.
narrative.general_summary: Zavo is a data research lab selling to frontier AI developers, a category with huge demand in 2025 and with strong leaders in Surge, Mercor and Scale. Cohort anchors for AI and B2B companies give about 59 to 64 percent seed ever, and about 70 percent of those land in 13 months, so the window estimate is 45 percent. Later rounds in the window are tail events. Customer concentration and thin margins are the main risks. The odds do not rank this company against others.

assumptions: The input has no customers or revenue; seed odds assume a normal Fall 2025 AI B2B company.
Window 13.4 months; seed means a round above about 1M from outside investors closing inside it.
Data lab analog records were read for categories only; later dated outcomes of analogs are not used as evidence.
